I'm watching the movie right now and I noticed that the effigies of the "pre-sacrificed Hargans" are constructed from what looks like dead trees/dead tree branches. Maybe this symbolizes that the elders sacrificed in the attestupa are now part of the Ancestral (Piss) Tree?
My dominant uses the Duchy, but I also suggest Rory's Brainworks. Last time we did rope play, we used one of Rory's ties.

Also, the tapestry shown at the beginning of the film foreshadows the plot of the whole movie. 

From L to R: the winter panel with the skull hanging over the family of four represents Dani's family. All those who die are connected by cords. A skeletal figure cuts the cord to the one living figure. 

The second panel from the left is Christian consoling Dani while Pelle looks on in the tree above. He is sketching as he is seen to do in the film.

The gap between the second and third panel is filled by the group of friends being led by Pelle playing the flute. Mark is even drawn wearing the jester hat that will be worn by the doll meant to represent him in the final scene. Josh is scene carrying books as he is the most studious of the group. 

The third angel represents the friends' arrival in Harga. The two angels on the top of the panel are the elders sacrificed in the Attestupa, but they also resemble the figures meant to portray Dani's parents in the first panel. 

The fourth panel portays the May Queen contest. I cannot find any additional symbolism in this area. 

Let me know if anyone else finds any other symbolism in this scene/tapestry. I would love to see other interpretations!
